title: Sarevok's Wretched Armour
summary: Inaccessible Heavy Armour gives AC 20, damage reduction and a retaliatory barrier.

fields.Defence: AC 20. Heavy Armour with no Dexterity bonus. Reduce incoming damage by 2.
fields.Withering Barrier: Dealing Necrotic damage grants 1d6 temporary HP. If hit in melee while you still have temporary HP, deal 1d6 Piercing to all creatures within 10 ft.
fields.Availability: Unobtainable in normal play. Sarevok wears Plate Armour +2 in combat.
fields.Base value: No nominal price listed by the source.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
